svg.title: How phytyl-tail-builder rebuilds a tail
svg.desc: tleap adds the missing tail atoms and logs them; the tool maps them to residues, rebuilds each tail in torsion space with natural stereochemistry, rebuilds all tails again with the others in place, writes a hydrogen-free PDB and a stereo report, and passes the structure back to tleap only if every tail is (R,R,E) with every bond angle within 20 degrees of natural phytyl; otherwise it exits with status 3.
